'''Darth Hoth MBO''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Hoth]]
* '''Published:''' 14 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Docking Bay|Premiere-L-yavin4dockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4: Docking Bay
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Yavin 4 Docking Bay Hoth LS 2003.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

speed blow up

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

Use Strike Planning to get General Dodonna and Mon. Use Dodonna to get Gospic and later pilots, Mon to get Techs. With the number of Lukes and Red 5s in there, I should get one fairly quickly, then I can use it to search for the other. Deploy him to Yavin and move him over to the Death Star. If all the techs are out, you have 6 (3 techs with Gospic)+7 (Luke (V))+4 (Yavin site)=17+destiny.

After the ball's gone, spread and drain at Coruscant and Kessel mostly, or beatdown if the opponent has a space deck.
